    Questions

    How often should a septic tank be emptied?

    Usually every 3 to 5 years for a household, depending on tank size and number of users.

    Do I need to be home?

    Someone should show where the tank cover is. Tell us if it is buried and we will help find it.

    How long does it take?

    Most homes take 30 to 60 minutes once the crew arrives.
